title: SUMO Fusion-Based Functional Rescue of SUMOylation-Defective Protein in Drosophila
author: Imai, Wu, et al.
materials: NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly Master Mix

steps.title: Collect and wash OSCs
steps.instruction: Collect 3 × 10⁶ ovarian somatic cells (OSCs) per sample into a tube and wash the cells once with phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS).

steps.title: Resuspend cells in transfection buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed cells in 100 µL Mannitol transfection buffer.

steps.title: Add plasmids to cell suspension
steps.instruction: Add the following plasmids to the 100 µL cell suspension: 2 µL pUb‑14boxB‑Luc (300 ng/µL) and 3 µL vector plasmid (1 µg/µL). Vector plasmids may be any of the constructs expressing (i) wild‑type protein of interest, (ii) a loss‑of‑function mutant (e.g., K→R), or (iii) SUMO‑fusion variants (e.g., SUMO‑GG or SUMO‑AA fused to the mutant).

steps.title: Electroporate cells
steps.instruction: Transfer each 105 µL sample (post‑plasmid addition) to an electroporation cuvette and electroporate using program T‑029 on the Nucleofector II device.

steps.title: Plate cells and incubate
steps.instruction: Plate the electroporated cells into three wells of a 24‑well plate, adding 500 µL culture medium per well, then incubate at 26 °C for 24 h.

steps.title: Harvest cells and lyse
steps.instruction: Harvest cells for the luciferase assay as follows:

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the culture medium from each well.
Wash each well once with PBS.
Add 150 µL Glo Lysis Buffer to each well.
Lyse cells by shaking at 120 rpm for 10 min at 25 °C.
Transfer the lysates to 1.5‑mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge at 15,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Dispense 15 µL ONE‑Glo luciferase assay substrate into each well of a round‑bottom, white 96‑well plate.
Add 15 µL cleared cell lysate to the substrate and mix gently.

Measure firefly luciferase activity on a Cytation 5 plate reader in luminescence mode (endpoint measurement, 3.0 s integration, 100 ms delay, top reading, gain 135, no excitation/emission filters, white opaque plate, detection range 300–700 nm).
CRITICAL: After centrifugation, collect supernatant carefully without disturbing the pellet to avoid debris contamination.

steps.title: Determine protein concentration
steps.instruction: Measure total protein using the Bradford assay:

substeps.instruction: Mix 5 µL cleared lysate with 500 µL Bradford reagent.
Transfer 150 µL of the mixture to a flat‑bottom, clear 96‑well plate.
Measure absorbance at 595 nm with a microplate reader.

steps.title: Normalize luciferase to protein
steps.instruction: Normalize each sample’s luciferase activity to its total protein concentration to obtain the final relative activity values.
